summary: Reverse address lookup — residents, owners, and neighbors.
detail: Searches property records for an address and returns current and past residents, property owner, and neighboring properties. Good for linking an address to a person and vice versa.

Review current and past resident list

Review building details: height, floors, year built, architect

summary: Crowdsourced street-level imagery — covers areas Google misses.

name: FIRMS (NASA Fire Map)

name: SunCalc
summary: Calculate sun position and shadow direction for any location and time.
detail: Shows the sun's position, shadow direction, and azimuth for any location at any date and time. Use to verify the time a photo was taken by analyzing shadow angles.

Set the date to the claimed photo date
proTip: Shadow analysis combined with EXIF timestamp can confirm or refute a photo's claimed location and time.

Filter by feature type (city, mountain, river, etc.)

summary: Search engine for geographic web services — WMS, WFS, WMTS endpoints.

Review discovered map services

detail: Google Earth Engine hosts a massive catalog of satellite imagery and geospatial datasets: Landsat, Sentinel, MODIS, climate data, terrain data, and more. Free for research use.

Use the Code Editor (free account required) to analyze datasets

Wallet view shows balance and all transactions
